_comment: Curated FireRed (BPRE0) obtain data. As of the latest tooling, the ONLY entry still actively used is 'roaming': the roaming beast's species is chosen in ASM by your starter (confirmed with read_script - InitRoamer has no species literal), so it genuinely can't be read from script/table data. Everything else here (fightingDojo, gameCorner, eventTicket) is now AUTO-DETECTED from the ROM - the Dojo Hitmons via givePokemon-VAR resolution, the Game Corner prizes/costs via export_coin_prizes (the menu text), and all three ticket legendaries via the StartLegendaryBattle special - so those sections remain only as documentation / fallbacks and don't feed the dump on vanilla.

fightingDojo.note: After defeating the Karate Master, take ONE of the two Poke Balls (Lv25). These are now AUTO-DETECTED by export_script_encounters: each ball does `setvar VAR_TEMP_1 <species>` then a shared `givePokemon VAR_TEMP_1`, and the var-tracker resolves the var (set exactly once per ball) to the species. This list is only a fallback + the mutually-exclusive choice group; it is NOT ASM-hardcoded (an earlier note wrongly said so - reading the script with read_script disproved it).

gameCorner.note: Bought with coins from the Pokemon prize clerk (vendor script @ 0x16CB88; the give sits in a menu jump-table the standard script walk can't reach). The dump now reads the species + costs LIVE from the ROM via the export_coin_prizes MCP tool (scripts.text.multichoice options, e.g. text 'PORYGON 9,999 COINS') - so an edited ROM reports its own prizes. The list below is only a fallback for when that tool's output is absent. SCYTHER is the FireRed prize (LeafGreen swaps in PINSIR).
gameCorner.costSource: export_coin_prizes tool reads scripts.text.multichoice option text '<SPECIES> <n> COINS' (vanilla FireRed: options @ 0x3E01C8)

roaming.note: Post-National-Dex: exactly ONE legendary beast roams Kanto, determined by your starter choice. Set up in code, not in the wild table.

eventTicket.note: ALL THREE (Lugia, Ho-Oh, Deoxys) are now AUTO-DETECTED by export_script_encounters (kind=legendary: the StartLegendaryBattle special with species/level in VAR_0x8004/0x8005). Ho-Oh's Navel Rock summit is a step-on coord-trigger event, which the walk now covers, so nothing here is used as a fallback any more. All three need an event-distributed ticket item to reach in-game. MEW / CELEBI / JIRACHI were distribution-only (no in-game route) and are left unobtainable.
